comment: Decision-group extensions (G27), merged into tools/lib/provenance-rules.mjs by BOTH enforcement layers. The six built-in groups (rls-policy, guc-identity, token-verification, vector-index, llm-sampling, tuning-constants) cover the stack-neutral security/LLM surface; this file carries the classes beyond them. The template SEEDS `mobile-security` — ATS/cleartext exceptions, Android permission strings, the runtimeVersion policy, and the updates URL are the locked mobile decision sites of the design record, so their constants carry a citation duty from day one. Add YOUR project's research/domain decision classes here too (a RAG chunk size, a similarity threshold, a sampling seed). Each group: {"key": "lowercase-kebab", "description": "...", "patterns": ["regex-source", ...]}. A group you add MUST also gain a corpus entry tagged with its key (the provenance gate's coverage lockstep enforces this). Write-guard-protected: extending the taxonomy is a reviewed act — and the seeded group is a floor, never remove it.

groups.description: Mobile transport/permission/update security — ATS and cleartext exceptions, Android permission strings, runtimeVersion policy, the EAS updates URL
